description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330012863516 PAC KING,PREFORMED: Line 0001 Qty 72 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0068 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
